data.title: 妮姆芙 · 钟楼顶端微风水手服的青空眺望
data.description: 小镇学校古典钟楼顶层的露天阳台，妮姆芙身穿深蓝初中海军水手服，双马尾随风拂动，手握纸风车，静静远眺广阔无垠的自由天空。
data.location: 古典红砖学校钟楼观景台
data.action: 双手扶着石砌护栏，水蓝色双马尾如丝绸般随强风在空中飘扬，神情恬静而深情地望着蓝天白云
data.lighting: 清澈透明的高空晨光，晴空万里，微风拂动发丝的高光层次分明
data.camera: 背侧平视微仰，将少女的娇小背影与浩瀚晴空完美结合
data.promptProse: 1girl, solo, nymph, angeloid, long aqua blue twintails fluttering in high wind, blue eyes, junior high school navy sailor suit, white pleated skirt, navy sailor collar with red scarf tie, standing at open balcony of red brick clock tower, holding colorful pinwheel, gazing at vast pure blue sky with fluffy white clouds, serene peaceful smile, feeling of true freedom.
data.animaCaption: 1girl, solo, nymph, blue twintails, navy sailor uniform looking at vast blue sky from clock tower balcony.
